text:
maria: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 502/504s from hosted inference in eu-west-1 since ~09:20 UTC. High-level: requests with long context (>4k tokens) often time out or return partial responses. Support ticket CS-7893 attached. Oncall please triage.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 — EU gateway 5xx spike. War room thread opened.

raj: I'm on it. Can folks paste any trace_ids + sample requests. Any deploys around 09:10-09:25?

olivia: There was a small runtime kernel-selection tweak deployed at 09:12 (aten kernel heuristics). Rolling back now if we see correlation.

kevin: Customer provided trace_id=abcd-1234; sample repro via curl returns 502 consistently when context > ~4k:

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.io/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<~5k tokens>"}]}'
```

maria: Gateway logs excerpt:

```
ERROR http 502 upstream timeout backend=runtime-01 latency=18000ms trace=abcd-1234
WARN gateway retry exhausted for route=/v1/chat
```

raj: Quick repro locally when I simulate many long-context requests — backend compile/kv-cache thrashing increases compile-queue depth and we hit our 15s backend timeout. Hypothesis: kernel-selection change increased CPU jitter on compile hot paths causing stalls.

olivia: As immediate mitigation I increased backend timeout 15s -> 30s for eu-west route and enabled automatic fallback to redwood-small model for requests exceeding 4k context. Also initiating rollback of the kernel-selection change.

kevin: Communicated temporary fallback + retry guidance to affected customers. SDKs will retry once on 502 with exponential backoff; asking customers to upgrade to SDK v2.3.1 which respects new retry defaults.

maria: Action items (short term):
1) Rollback kernel patch — olivia — ETA 20m.
2) Keep backend timeout at 30s for eu-west until next validation — raj — done.
3) Enable route-level auto-fallback to redwood-small for >4k contexts — olivia — done.
4) Customer comms summary and RCA draft — kevin + maria — due EOD tomorrow.
5) Create INF ticket for KV cache TTL tuning + prefetch and synthetic long-context tests — research-bot assigned INF-1122.

olivia: Kernel patch rolled back at 09:48 UTC. Monitoring metrics now.

research-bot: INF-1122 created: "KV cache prefetch + TTL adjustments for long-context workloads" — owners: eng-ml (raj) + eng-runtime (olivia).

sre-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Error rate returned to baseline at 09:56 UTC.

maria: Closing war room for now. Drafting postmortem: will include full timeline, decision log, mitigation steps, and customers impacted. Long-term fixes to include:
- adaptive timeout per model/seqlen
- model-variant auto-fallback (lighter models for long contexts)
- KV cache prefetch and TTL policy
- compile-queue backpressure circuit

kevin: I'll send affected customers the summary and ETA for permanent fixes tomorrow morning. PRs and Jira links will be included.

raj: For the postmortem please include these metrics and charts: kvcache_miss_rate, compile_queue_depth, runtime_cpu_steal, backend_request_latency p95/p99 during window.

maria: Noted. Assigning owners in the postmortem doc. Thanks everyone for quick response :thumbsup:

support-bot: Linked support tickets: CS-7893, CS-7894, CS-7895.

maria: Follow-ups:
- olivia: confirm kernel rollback SR+post-rollback validation by EOD.
- raj: add synthetic long-context tests and alert threshold for kvcache_miss_rate.
- kevin/maria: postmortem + customer RCA draft by tomorrow EOD.
- eng-runtime: evaluate adaptive timeouts and model-variant fallback design (deliverable in 2 sprints).

olivia: Will validate rollback and post back with traces + dashboard snapshots.

sre-bot: War room closed at 09:58 UTC. Incident transitioned to postmortem tracking.
